tools.name: confirm_chart_spec
tools.description: Ask the user to confirm (or reject) a proposed chart specification before running it, when the request is broad or ambiguous (no specific fields/filters, or spans the whole dataset).

reason.description: Why confirmation is needed, shown to the user.
